prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1075; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle was stationary and struck on the rear quarter panel by a third-party vehicle reversing from a space. Both drivers exited and exchanged information. Police not called. Photos of both vehicles requested from insured. Liability appears clear pending statements.

Entry 2: Claimant is represented by counsel. All contact to be routed through the attorney's office going forward. Notice of representation received and filed. Claimant reports lower back strain following the impact and states she sought evaluation at an urgent care clinic the same day. Medical records requested with signed authorization.

Entry 3: Insured's recorded statement taken. Insured confirms the other vehicle backed out of a space without signaling and contacted the rear passenger side. No prior damage noted by insured. Estimate for repairs to be obtained from preferred shop. Rental coverage confirmed under insured's policy.

Entry 4: Attorney's office sent a demand package including the urgent care record, a physical therapy referral, and a request for a reserve review. Treating provider notes limited range of motion and muscle spasm in the lumbar region. Treatment plan calls for eight weeks of physical therapy. Medical review scheduled to assess whether treatment is consistent with the reported mechanism of injury.

Entry 5: Reserves adjusted to reflect ongoing physical therapy and possible additional imaging. Supervisor notified of represented status and open injury component. Response to attorney's demand package acknowledged in writing, with a request for the complete treatment file and wage documentation. Follow-up diary set for review after receipt of records.
